q4_green_2020_top_zone.sql: SELECT pickup_zone, SUM(revenue_monthly_total_amount) revenue FROM prod.fct_monthly_zone_revenue WHERE service_type='Green' AND revenue_month >= '2020-01-01' AND revenue_month < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q5_green_october_2019_trips.sql: SELECT SUM(total_monthly_trips) FROM prod.fct_monthly_zone_revenue WHERE service_type='Green' AND revenue_month='2019-10-01'
